# Division 296 tax: what it is and what it means for you
The Division 296 tax introduces an additional tax on certain super earnings for individuals whose Total Superannuation Balance (TSB) exceeds the large super balance threshold (LSBT), set at $3 million for the 2026–27 financial year.
